notes: Link's kits (v9.9). Slot 0, the Master Sword, keeps his look (the guard picture already holds a sword and the shield): its kit swings the glowing blade. Slot 1, the Bow of Light, changes the look (guard picture w1guard: the golden bow in his left hand, the shield on his back): its states are generated too. Arrows of light, the rain of light and the sword beam are drawn by the game; the beam and both ultimates keep their clips; the arrow (w1_nspecial) is redone in the new look.

w0_jab: first hit of a fast three-hit sword combo: a quick diagonal downward slash of the Master Sword from high in front of him to low in front of him, the blade glowing with a soft blue-white light, the shield kept on his other arm, then back into the stance
w0_jab2: second hit: a fast flat backhand slash of the Master Sword straight across in front of him at chest height, a thin blue-white trail, then back into the stance
w0_jab3: finisher: steps forward and swings the Master Sword in a powerful rising arc from low in front of him up over his head, a bright blue-white trail, then back into the stance
w0_nair: air combo in mid-air: slashes the Master Sword down in front of him, then spins with a full circle cut around his body, thin blue-white trails, then back to the tucked pose
w0_sspecial: spin attack: crouches holding the Master Sword low behind him, charging, then spins around once on the spot with the sword held out flat, a full circle cut around his body with a blue-white trail, then back into the stance
w0_uspecial: rising jump slash: crouches, then leaps straight up swinging the Master Sword in a big upward arc over his head, a blue-white trail, rising the whole time, ending in mid-air with the sword raised
w0_dspecial: perfect guard: raises his round shield in front of him and braces, perfectly still and watchful, then answers with a quick forward slash of the Master Sword, then back into the stance

1.subject: Link from Zelda Tears of the Kingdom, a young hero with blond hair in a small ponytail, a blue Champion tunic, brown belt and boots, an arm with green glowing runes, holding the golden Bow of Light in his left hand, his shield on his back
1.guard_pose: archer stance facing right, the golden Bow of Light held forward in his left hand, an arrow of light nocked
1.air_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, the golden Bow of Light in his left hand

w1_jab: first shot of a fast three-shot combo: draws and looses a single golden arrow of light straight forward in one quick motion, the bow staying in his left hand, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_jab2: second shot: quickly nocks two arrows of light and looses them forward together, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrows flying away
w1_jab3: finisher: draws a big blazing arrow of light back to his cheek, holds the aim an instant, then looses it with a strong recoil, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_nair: air shot: turns in mid-air and looses an arrow of light diagonally down in front of him, then back to the tucked pose. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_sspecial: triple shot: draws three arrows of light at once and looses them in a spread forward, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrows flying away
w1_uspecial: rising shot: leaps straight up and, near the top, aims the Bow of Light straight down and looses an arrow of light below him, rising the whole time. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_dspecial: rain of light: aims the Bow of Light straight up at the sky, draws and looses an arrow of light upward, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_nspecial: arrow of light: nocks one golden arrow of light, draws the Bow of Light fully back to his cheek and holds the aim an instant, then looses it with a sharp recoil, then back into the stance. Only Link and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w1_bthrow: throw backward: turns and heaves the invisible opponent over his shoulder behind him with his free right hand, the golden Bow of Light kept in his left hand, then returns to the ready stance, no arrow nocked. Only Link is drawn: no person, no sack, no dust, nothing flying
w1_grabbed: held up by the collar from in front of him: chest pulled forward, head tilted back in pain, his right hand clutching at the collar at his throat, his left hand still gripping the golden Bow of Light hanging down, no arrow, legs kicking and squirming, a seamless loop. Only Link is drawn: the opponent is invisible
